tools.name: voice_speak
tools.description: Speak text aloud with the active LeeWay voice. Prepares the best voice for this device automatically and fails over visibly if a provider breaks.

tools.name: voice_stop
tools.description: Stop speech immediately. Does not cancel upstream reasoning.

tools.name: voice_list_voices
tools.description: List the available voice packages (28 Kokoro model voices, device voice, optional clone).

tools.name: voice_select_voice
tools.description: Select a voice package by ID, for example "kokoro-am_michael".

tools.name: voice_status
tools.description: Report the active provider, device, selected voice, the provider plan, any fallback in effect and the last error.

tools.name: voice_device_profile
tools.description: Probe this device (WebGPU, WebAssembly, memory, audio output, speech voices) and return the provider plan with reasons.

tools.name: voice_diagnostics
tools.description: Read device diagnostics: the native host snapshot and, when a loopback LeeWay Device Bridge URL and owner token are supplied, its health and passport.

tools.name: voice_self_test
tools.description: Run a measured voice self-test (probe, diagnostics, prepare, synthesis). Set audible to also play a short phrase.
